keyFindings.description: The replace pins sjawhar/ygo v1.51.3-sami.8, which carries the checkParkedDeletes defect (sami.6-sami.9; dispatch://INFRA-644/message/4406c084): an update refused after it integrated is kept by the room and never sent to other peers. Main pins sami.4 (clear), so merging this head introduces the defect. Move the pin to v1.51.3-sami.10 once tagged (not tagged at review time: gh api repos/sjawhar/ygo/tags lists sami.9 as newest).

spliceTouched's ask fallback discards ReadForRendering's error (tree, _ :=) and returns askBlockIDs(nil), an empty map, with no log; observeAskBlocks then forgets every ask author and resets the room's ask baseline to empty, which the whole path never does (its read error passes nil asks and records nothing). Log the errors and record nothing on failure.

holdsFlags (pmdoc) and walkAskBlocks (docs/ask_authors.go:41) each write the ask-block walk and its text skip rule; Layout.AskBlocks must agree with askBlockIDs for the incremental path's ask ids to equal the whole path's, and nothing ties them. One walk in pmdoc, used by both.

markdown *string and layout *pmdoc.Layout must be nil together, stated in three places and re-checked at tree.go:955, with two copy-the-string workarounds (678, 779-781). One rendering struct (markdown, layout) held by pointer makes the invariant structural; loadedRendering already is that pair.

The comment says nothing in touched outlives the update's classification, but observe resets it before each apply, not after classify: the last update's block references (possibly a deleted element) stay held until the next update. Reset after classify too, and correct the comment.
blockChangeFinder is an interface with one implementation (changedTypesFinder) and no test double; the finder field, the interface and renderWhole are indirection over one OnAfterTransaction call.
tree.go grows 757 -> 1066 lines; the replica (struct, observe, finder, splice, keep, start/recover, keepReplica) is one unit and belongs in its own replica.go.
stormPeer duplicates typingBrowser's sync/send/editTree (render_reuse_test.go:1278-1310) and they already differ (EnsureBlockIDs in one editTree only); one peer helper for both tests.

Prose: the changelog's list of whole-render cases omits >64 touched blocks, a fragment attribute change, no layout yet and a touched block no longer among the children; AGENTS.md has a dangling 'rejected for' line break (664), history narration (654, 896), and a sentence about a state the code says cannot happen (915).
